original_metadata.title: An explicit defining presentation of the diagonal gl n reduction algebra for n at least four over its localized Cartan enveloping algebra
original_metadata.author: Sergei Khoroshkin; Oleg Ogievetsky
original_metadata.source_title: Structure Constants of Diagonal Reduction Algebras of gl Type
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The extremal-projector product defines structure constants by an infinite root-lattice expansion, so ordinary enveloping-algebra PBW relations do not give the required presentation. The authors compute the needed rank-three/four components through the ABRR recurrence, control which weights can survive stabilization, and propagate coefficients by Zhelobenko braid automorphisms. Separate Cartan and opposite-root calculations complete the six relation families before the established presentation criterion can be applied.

proof_review.note: Read exact localized double-coset definition3.1 and Cartan denominators, all generator normalizations/braid actions and relation types in Section4.3, stabilization Lemma4/Corollary5 and Section5.1 ABRR tensor recurrence, full braid induction5.2 and all six authored relation-family derivations5.3 through physical26. The rank-three/four explicit projector calculations are extended by weight restrictions and uniquely forced braid coefficient recursions, with commutative Cartan and opposite-root families derived separately. Previously published reduction-algebra presentation criterion[7] is background; it is applied only after this source supplies the substantive new relation verification. No cut map, small-rank variant, braid lemma or individual relation counted. Original selected statement/core pages rendered and visually inspected; exact header and native ZIP members verified. Editorial scope and warnings are retained.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Theorem3 for n>=4: Z_n is the diagonal gl_n reduction algebra defined as the double coset of U(gl_n) tensor U(gl_n), localized by every h_ij+ell for integer ell and i<j, with extremal-projector multiplication. The six explicitly displayed relation families(4.12),(4.13),(4.14),(4.16),(4.17),(4.18), together with the standing Cartan weight conventions, define the algebra on the weight generators z_ij,t_i and are equivalent over the localized Cartan ring to its ordering relations(3.3). Renormalized variables and shifted h are those of Sections2/4.1.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: The printed symbol U(h) carries the source localization convention; it must not be read as an unlocalized polynomial coefficient ring. The prior presentation criterion[7] is cited background, while all required new relation checks are included in full original pages. No isolated small-rank example is counted.
